intro_html:
Rally the corgi has sniffed out the best Christmas events for kids in Longmont for 2026, and here is what he found: 8 family events, 5 of them free. The magic runs from December 3 (Holiday Open House at Callahan House) through December 31 (Noon Year's Party), with Holiday Toy Making and Ice Skating Show in Longmont (December 5), Santa Visit at Callahan House (December 10) and Longmont Lights Holiday Parade (December 12) along the way. We check every date on the host's own website, and each listing links straight there.

What Rally found in Longmont

  • 8 Christmas events for kids in Longmont
  • 5 free events, including the Holiday Open House at Callahan House, the Longmont Lights Holiday Parade and Best Books of 2026 Storytime
  • Meet Santa: Santa Visit at Callahan House, December 10, lottery registration, and Breakfast with Santa at Jesters Dinner Theatre, December 21
  • Parade and crafts: Longmont Lights Holiday Parade and Crafts and Cocoa at the Library
  • Season: December 3, 2026 to December 31, 2026

Planning a bigger day out? Longmont families also use our guide to Christmas activities for kids in Denver, which covers Zoo Lights, Blossoms of Light at the Denver Botanic Gardens and the big downtown tree lightings.
